title: Delivery Service Terms for Ridgeline Orders & Delivery: Windows, Redelivery and Late Shipments
content:
## 1. Missed delivery windows

1.1 Under Ridgeline Orders & Delivery, a delivery arriving more than the program's lateness minutes after the end of the booked delivery window, or a truck that misses the booked window, earns the program's missed-window credit once per order.

1.2 The driver or crew records each delivery attempt on the order with its outcome (delivered in window, delivered late, truck missed window, customer absent, or refused as damaged) and the moment the truck arrived.

*Illustration (hypothetical figures).* With a window ending at 14:00 and an assumed lateness allowance of 45 minutes, an arrival at 14:45 is not more than 45 minutes after the end and is not late; an arrival at 14:50 is late and earns the credit. A second late arrival on the same order earns nothing further, because the credit is earned once per order.

## 2. Failed deliveries

A delivery that cannot be completed because no adult was present or the site was inaccessible incurs the program's redelivery charge, and the order is held at the store for the program's store-hold days for redelivery or pickup. When a delivery attempt fails the order goes back from out for delivery to ready, and the order record counts the failed attempts.

## 3. Moving a delivery window

3.1 A delivery window can be moved only while the order status is placed or ready. The status is read from the order record of the order whose window is to be moved, as it stands before the move.

| Order status in the order record | Window may be moved |
|---|---|
| Placed | Yes |
| Ready | Yes |
| Out for delivery, fulfilled, cancelled or returned | No |

3.2 A delivery may be moved free when the request is made at least the program's notice hours before the start of the delivery window and the number of customer reschedules already recorded on the order is below the program's limit of free reschedules; any other move incurs the program's redelivery charge.

| Request made at least the notice hours before the window start | Customer reschedules on the order below the free limit | Charge for the move |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | None, the move is free |
| Yes | No | The program's redelivery charge |
| No | Yes | The program's redelivery charge |
| No | No | The program's redelivery charge |

*Boundary illustration (hypothetical figures).* Assume a notice of 12 hours and a limit of 2 free reschedules, with a window starting at 10:00. A request made at 22:00 the evening before is exactly 12 hours ahead and meets the notice; one made at 23:00 is 11 hours ahead and does not. An order showing 1 customer reschedule is below the limit of 2; an order showing 2 is not.

A move that is made records the new window on the order and the updated number of customer reschedules.

## 4. Late shipped orders

A shipped order arriving more than the program's late-shipment days after the promised date has its shipping charge refunded as a late shipment refund credit. The days are calendar days. *Illustration (hypothetical figures):* with an assumed allowance of 2 days and a promised date of 2026-09-14, arrival on 2026-09-16 is 2 days after and not more than the allowance; arrival on 2026-09-17 is 3 days after and the shipping charge is refunded.

## 5. Missed-window credit and delivery charge refund on one order

The missed-window credit and a delivery charge refund are not combined on one order when the program marks them as not combinable: the customer receives the larger of the two. *Illustration (hypothetical figures):* an order that has earned a missed-window credit of $25.00 and also qualifies for a delivery charge refund of $60.00 receives $60.00, the larger amount, and not both.
